select
vvs_parent,
org_einheit,
'VVS '||vvs||' '||org_ltext
from
(
select 
*
from
(

SELECT

distinct
case 
  when substr(vvs,1,2) in ('10','13','14','15','16','17','18','19')
       or substr(vvs,1,4) in ('2203')
  then 'A_'||substr(vvs,1,4)||'00'
  else 'A_SONSTIGE'
  end VVS_Parent,
replace('A_'||NVL(VVS,'NA'),'A_0','A_NA') ORG_EINHEIT,
'AVS',
'N',
vvs

FROM
dtl_nvr_ertraege e

WHERE
stichtag=(select stichtag from nvr_parameter)
and vvs is not NULL
AND herkunft <>'DTL_NVR_PROVISIONEN'

UNION

SELECT

distinct
case
  when substr(vvs,1,2) in ('10','13','14','15','16','17','18','19')
       or substr(vvs,1,4) in ('2203')
  then 'A_'||substr(vvs,1,4)||'00'
  else 'A_SONSTIGE'
  end,
replace('A_'||NVL(VVS,'NA'),'A_0','A_NA'),
'AVS',
'N',
vvs

FROM
dtl_nvr_provisionen_neu p

WHERE
stichtag=(select stichtag from nvr_parameter)
and vvs is not NULL
)	
) a
,
(select org_ktext, org_ltext from org_historien@dws1 where vt_dat=to_date('4000-12-31','YYYY-MM-DD')  and trim(TRANSLATE(org_ktext, '0123456789-,.', ' ')) is null and org_ktext is not null ) b

where a.vvs=b.org_ktext
